prompt.text:
Implement and export exactly `{ replaceOwned }`. `replaceOwned(root, segments, replacement)` performs an immutable replacement along an existing path. `segments` must be a non-empty array of strings; otherwise throw `TypeError`. Traversal may pass through non-null objects or arrays but must use own properties only. For arrays, a segment is valid only when it is the canonical decimal form of an existing index (`'0'` is valid, `'00'` is not). If any segment is absent or traversal reaches a primitive too early, return `{ changed: false, value: root }`. On success return `{ changed: true, value }`, where only containers on the traversed path are shallow-cloned, untouched branches preserve their original identities, and the supplied replacement is assigned by reference. Never mutate `root`, `segments`, or any nested source container. Empty objects and arrays are valid roots but cannot contain a successful non-empty path.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
